data.additional_information:
JOB Description – Business Analyst
Market Research, Industry Intelligence & Strategic Analysis
Leumas · Bengaluru
Leumas is seeking a Business Analyst to drive structured market research, industry intelligence, and data-driven insights to support business strategy and account growth.
This role is primarily responsible for analysing market landscapes, evaluating competitive environments, and generating actionable insights that inform client engagement, product positioning, and strategic decision-making. The position requires strong analytical capability, disciplined research methodologies, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, business-relevant outputs.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for regulated healthcare manufacturing. Its integrated Manufacturing Operating System enables modular, scalable, and compliant production across nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, and wellness products.
Leumas partners with brands across early-stage, growth-stage, and enterprise segments, delivering end-to-end product development and manufacturing solutions.

The Role
As Business Analyst, you will be responsible for building a comprehensive understanding of markets, customer segments, product trends, and competitive landscapes relevant to Leumas’ business.
You will work closely with Business Development, NPD, and leadership teams to provide structured research outputs and strategic insights, enabling more informed decision-making across client engagements and growth initiatives.
The role requires a methodical approach to research, strong attention to detail, and the ability to synthesize insights into actionable recommendations.

What You Will Own
1. Market Research & Industry Analysis (Primary Responsibility)
• Conduct in-depth research across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and wellness markets.
• Analyze industry structure, demand trends, product categories, and growth drivers.
• Develop comprehensive market maps, segmentations, and opportunity landscapes.
• Identify emerging trends, whitespace opportunities, and high-potential segments.
2. Competitor Landscaping & Benchmarking
• Map competitor capabilities, product portfolios, manufacturing models, and positioning strategies.
• Conduct benchmarking across pricing, formats, ingredients, and go-to-market approaches.
• Identify competitive gaps and differentiation opportunities for Leumas and its clients.
3. Primary Research & Data Collection
• Conduct structured primary research through stakeholder interactions, data gathering, and industry inputs.
• Collect, validate, and organize qualitative and quantitative data from multiple sources.
• Ensure reliability, relevance, and accuracy of research inputs.
4. Insight Generation & Strategic Recommendations
• Synthesize research findings into clear, structured insights and business implications.
• Develop reports, briefs, and presentations to support strategic discussions.
• Provide actionable recommendations for market entry, product positioning, and account growth.
5. Account Intelligence & Business Support
• Build detailed intelligence on client accounts, including product portfolios, target markets, and competitive positioning.
• Support Business Development and Account Management teams with research-backed inputs.
• Enable more informed client engagement, cross-sell, and upsell strategies.

Candidate Profile (You’re a Fit If)
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree (UG) in any discipline.
• You demonstrate:
o Strong interest in market research, industry analysis, and business strategy.
o Structured analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
o Ability to synthesize large volumes of information into clear insights.
o Strong attention to detail and data orientation.
o Good written and verbal communication skills.
• You are keen to build a career in business analysis, market intelligence, or strategy.

How You Will Operate
• Approach research with structure, rigor, and clarity.
• Ensure accuracy, depth, and relevance in all analysis.
• Translate complex data into actionable business insights.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.
• Maintain high standards of documentation and reporting.

Why Join
• Opportunity to work on high-impact market and strategy problems.
• Exposure to diverse industries within healthcare and wellness manufacturing.
• Strong learning curve in research, strategy, and business decision-making.
• Direct contribution to business growth and strategic direction.

Role Details
• Role Type: Full-time
• Location: Bengaluru (On-site)
• Function: Business Analysis / Market Research / Strategy
